mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 45 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park and a waning crescent moon overhead.

The Verona Common Council has officially adopted Envision Verona, a long-range comprehensive plan developed through extensive community input. This roadmap focuses on diverse housing, job growth, downtown development, and sustainable infrastructure to guide the city over the coming decades.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today you can visit Insight Wellness for yoga, stop by Art House 360 for comedy and art, or head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Later this week, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, plus the Puppets in the Park festival this Saturday.
Regarding local public safety, on September 28, officers responded to a collision at Enterprise Drive and East Verona Avenue involving a juvenile operating an eMoto recklessly.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Double Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
